title: Property care: recurring task catalogue
status: implementation proposal; all intervals adjustable recommendations

policy.unknown_history: initial_inspection_required; never manufacture last_done or mark every task overdue
policy.clock_separation: Inspection does not reset cleaning. Watering-needs check does not imply watered. Partial work resets only completed asset/area.
policy.due_rule: Calendar intervals run from actual verified completion in property local time; turnover rules apply once per turnover. No occupancy does not silently reset clock. A clean initial inspection may set an owner-approved prospective first cleaning due date, never a false last-cleaned date.
policy.overrides: Store property and asset cadence/product/manual overrides with author/reason/date. All intervals are adjustable recommendations; weekly curtains, monthly fans and fortnightly plant checks are starting examples, not fixed owner mandates. Shorten for heavy traffic/pets/coastal grit/dust/heat. Manuals and condition triggers can require earlier work.
policy.scheduling: No production schedule implied. Assign only tasks that fit owner-approved paid rotation minutes; default rotation budget unset, not extra unpaid time. Bundle nearby small tasks. Keep all other due work visible, not marked complete. Owner schedules separate undated quarterly deep clean. Safety/guest-ready issues escalate promptly, not deferred automatically to quarter.
policy.evidence: Photo proof required for every special-task completion and inspection: asset/location, current area, timestamp and cleaner. Before+after when soiled; after alone for ordinary completed area; inspection photo plus observation for inspected_clean. Missing/unusable proof => evidence_missing, never verified done. Avoid guests, documents, reflections and belongings. Photo cannot prove hidden sanitation.
policy.deep_clean: Quarterly owner review/planning cadence; actual booking date remains null until approved. Includes fabric washing, inaccessible/heavy furniture areas, complex dismantling and specialist work only after separate scope/access/paid time agreement.
policy.global_safety: No ladders/ceiling access, climbing furniture, electrical internals, heavy appliance moving, plumbing disassembly or chemical mixing. Use approved product labels, PPE and actual asset manual; stop/report mould concern, sharps, pests, damaged electrics, gas odour or unsafe access. Never generic caustic drain cleaner in dishwasher.
policy.appliance_scope: Exterior tasks do not replace after-use food-contact, milk-system, crumb tray, bowl or internal AC filter maintenance. Owner must add actual model-led tasks to routine checklist where applicable.

auto_attachment.target: next suitable future job at same property
eligible_when: task due by job date or open condition issue
confirmed asset applicability and safe access
auto_attachment.cancellation: Release assignment and carry same open cycle to next eligible job; preserve original due date
auto_attachment.missed_or_partial: Carry unfinished asset/action forward; no completion/date reset
auto_attachment.completion: Only confirmed completion with required evidence updates matching inspection or cleaning clock
auto_attachment.no_eligible_job: Show owner needs scheduling/time/access; do not silently drop or allocate unpaid minutes

sources.title: Bosch: cleaning a dishwasher filter
sources.basis: User-removable filter method; actual model instructions override baseline.

sources.title: Bosch UK: dishwasher maintenance
sources.basis: Monthly maintenance example; not a universal model requirement.

sources.title: Bosch: cleaning a ventilation hood
sources.basis: Check owner manual for filter removal and care; monthly baseline is operational recommendation.

sources.title: Samsung: clean your TV
sources.basis: Cool/isolate, gentle microfiber care and no direct spray; model-specific exceptions exist.

sources.title: Daikin Australia: filter cleaning frequency
sources.basis: Some internal AC filters need fortnightly care. External grille cleaning does not fulfil internal filter servicing.

sources.title: RHS: help a poorly houseplant
sources.basis: Check moisture and water when needed, not by a universal fixed watering interval.

items.title: Curtains, each room
items.procedure: Check hems, folds, stains, odour and fixings; gently vacuum reachable fabric with upholstery attachment if care label allows. Do not remove, wash or steam without approved fabric instructions; specialist washing belongs in the deep-clean plan.
items.condition_trigger: Visible dust, spills, odour, damaged hooks or mould concern
items.photo_requirement: Full curtain plus close-up of treated folds/issue

items.title: Window sills, each window
items.procedure: Vacuum loose grit; wipe with surface-approved lightly damp cloth and dry. Protect timber and paint; keep drainage openings clear without probing.
items.condition_trigger: Grit, insects, water pooling or condensation damage
items.photo_requirement: Sill and corners

items.title: Cobwebs, reachable corners
items.procedure: Use a clean extension duster from the floor; catch debris and vacuum floor below. Avoid fixtures, smoke detectors and fragile surfaces.
items.condition_trigger: Visible webs, repeated insect activity
items.photo_requirement: Named corner or cornice after treatment

items.title: Window glass, safe reachable faces
items.procedure: Spot-clean marks each turnover; clean reachable panes with approved glass product applied to cloth and dry streak-free. No leaning out or exterior height work.
items.condition_trigger: Fingerprints, salt film, grease or bird marks
items.photo_requirement: Whole named pane in angled light

items.title: Ceiling lights, reachable exterior only
items.procedure: Switch off and allow to cool. Dust only exterior safely reachable from floor with appropriate tool. Do not remove covers, bulbs or fittings; no ladder or electrical internals.
items.condition_trigger: Visible dust, insects inside cover, flickering or damage
items.photo_requirement: Fixture from floor; inaccessible/inside debris documented for owner

items.title: Under beds, each bed
items.procedure: Look with torch; retrieve only safe loose rubbish, vacuum reachable floor and edges. Do not lift heavy beds or dismantle frames; treat possessions as lost property.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, hair, rubbish, lost property or pest signs
items.photo_requirement: Under-bed floor from both accessible ends

items.title: TV stand, inside each compartment
items.procedure: Open owner-approved compartments, move light decor only, vacuum dust and wipe appropriate surfaces dry. Keep liquids away from equipment and preserve cable positions.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, crumbs, spills or blocked ventilation
items.photo_requirement: Each opened compartment

items.title: Behind TV stand
items.procedure: Vacuum reachable floor/gap without pulling the unit or straining cables. Move only an owner-approved light empty unit safely; otherwise photograph access limit.
items.condition_trigger: Dust accumulation, pests or cable damage
items.photo_requirement: Reachable rear gap and floor

items.title: Behind television, exterior surroundings
items.procedure: Turn off, cool and isolate only if safely accessible. Dry-dust reachable rear surroundings per manual; never detach wall mount, open casing, spray vents or pull cables. Report inaccessible areas.
items.condition_trigger: Dust at reachable surfaces or obstructed airflow
items.photo_requirement: Visible rear clearance without moving mounted TV

items.title: Behind sofas, each sofa
items.procedure: Vacuum accessible rear floor and skirting. Move only light approved furniture within safe handling limits and restore position; no heavy lifting.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, dropped items or spill
items.photo_requirement: Rear floor/gap of named sofa

items.title: Under sofas, each sofa
items.procedure: Use low-profile vacuum or safe extension to reach underneath; do not tilt or lift heavy sofa. Report inaccessible remainder.
items.condition_trigger: Hair, crumbs, rubbish or pests
items.photo_requirement: Visible underneath floor

items.title: Inside sofas and under removable cushions
items.procedure: Remove loose cushions only; check seams, vacuum exposed base/crevices and both cushion faces using upholstery tool; replace correctly. No mechanism or lining removal.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, hair, stains or lost property
items.photo_requirement: Exposed seat base before cushions replaced

items.title: All cupboard interiors, each compartment
items.procedure: Map every cupboard and shelf; work one assigned compartment at a time. Protect/temporarily remove owner-approved contents, vacuum, wipe compatible surfaces, dry fully, replace orderly. Never clear occupied guest storage.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, sticky residue, musty smell or pest evidence
items.photo_requirement: Each completed interior, including corners

items.title: All non-kitchen drawer interiors, each drawer
items.procedure: Map every drawer separately; inspect accessible owner-approved contents. Empty only as authorised, vacuum, wipe and dry before replacing. Do not force or remove fitted drawers.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, debris, spills or sticking
items.photo_requirement: Open named drawer showing full base

items.title: Cupboard and wardrobe mirrors
items.procedure: Spot-clean marks each turnover; use mirror-safe product on cloth, not frame/edges; dry without streaks. Avoid flooding backing or seals.
items.condition_trigger: Fingerprints, streaks or damage
items.photo_requirement: Whole mirror with no guests/private contents reflected

items.title: Kitchen drawer interiors, each drawer
items.procedure: Check for crumbs each turnover; rotate full empty-and-clean by drawer. Keep utensils on clean surface, vacuum corners, wipe food-contact compatible surfaces, dry and replace. Separate from non-kitchen drawer IDs.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, grease, sticky spills or pests
items.photo_requirement: Empty clean drawer before replacing utensils

items.title: Decorative living-room shelves, each shelf
items.procedure: Give every shelf its own instance/location. Remove safe light ornaments one at a time, dust shelf and item, replace layout. Leave fragile/heavy items and inaccessible heights for owner.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, rings or insects
items.photo_requirement: Whole named shelf and cleared surface where practical

items.title: Chairs and loose cushions, each chair
items.procedure: Inspect and spot-clean per fabric label; vacuum upholstery/seams and underneath removable seat cushions, then restore. Wipe hard chair surfaces with compatible product.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, hair, marks or loose fittings
items.photo_requirement: Chair plus exposed seat beneath removable cushion

items.title: Bin exteriors, lids and handles
items.procedure: Remove surface soil with approved product; clean lid, handle, body and pedal then dry. Keep waste cloths separate from kitchen/food cloths.
items.condition_trigger: Visible soil, stickiness or odour
items.photo_requirement: Lid/handle and exterior body

items.title: Bin interiors
items.procedure: After emptying, inspect liner leakage. Clean inner base/walls with approved product, rinse if label requires and dry before new liner. Never reach into unknown sharp waste.
items.condition_trigger: Leaks, odour, residue or pests; clean immediately when safe
items.photo_requirement: Empty inner base/walls before liner fitted

items.title: Oven-side accessible gaps
items.procedure: With appliance off and cool, vacuum accessible side/floor gaps using non-damaging nozzle. Never move oven, reach electrical/gas connections or insert tools into appliance openings.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, grease, pests or dropped food
items.photo_requirement: Each accessible side gap, noting hidden areas

items.title: Drawer tracks and any fitted seals
items.procedure: Brush/vacuum exposed tracks, wipe compatible accessible seals and dry. Do not dismantle runners or add lubricant without manual/owner instruction.
items.condition_trigger: Grit, sticking, damaged runner or seal
items.photo_requirement: Named drawer track/seal close-up

items.title: Sliding wardrobe tracks and seals
items.procedure: Vacuum channel and corners, brush loose debris and wipe dry; inspect accessible seals. Do not lift doors out or force rollers.
items.condition_trigger: Grit, sticking, damaged rollers or seal
items.photo_requirement: Track length plus corner/seal

items.title: Balcony and other sliding-door tracks/seals
items.procedure: Vacuum grit, wipe channel/seals with compatible cloth and dry. Keep visible designed drainage outlets unobstructed; do not drill/probe, remove door or lubricate without instructions.
items.condition_trigger: Sand, water pooling, sticking or damaged seals
items.photo_requirement: Named door track and drainage corner

items.title: Reachable air/AC vent grilles, exterior
items.procedure: Switch system off as instructed; vacuum/dust external grille gently without removing covers or pushing dust inward. No spray, coils, electrical parts or internal filter work in this task.
items.condition_trigger: Dust mat, reduced airflow, odour or moisture
items.photo_requirement: Whole named grille and close-up

items.title: Dishwasher interior and door seals
items.procedure: Inspect empty tub/seals for food or standing water; wipe accessible edges as manual allows. Monthly approved maintenance cycle only with correct machine product and booked time for cycle completion. No ordinary dish soap or drain chemicals.
items.condition_trigger: Food residue, odour, film, leaks or standing water
items.photo_requirement: Open empty tub/seals; cycle record if run, no sanitation claim

items.title: Dishwasher removable filter
items.procedure: Follow model manual to remove user-serviceable filter, remove food, rinse and gently brush as permitted; refit/lock correctly before use. Follow shorter manual interval, including after each wash if specified.
items.condition_trigger: Debris, smell or poor washing; clean sooner
items.photo_requirement: Filter after cleaning and correctly refitted position

items.title: Dishwasher visible drain/sump area
items.procedure: Inspect only safely visible drain area per manual; remove loose accessible food only if authorised. No pump cover, plumbing, sharp-object fishing or dismantling. Stop if blockage/standing water persists.
items.condition_trigger: Standing water, error code, glass or drainage failure
items.photo_requirement: Visible drain area/issue; hidden pipework cannot be certified

items.title: Rangehood exterior and accessible underside
items.procedure: Switch off and cool; wipe approved surfaces with suitable degreasing cloth and dry. Avoid controls, motor openings and abrasive pads.
items.condition_trigger: Grease film, drips or odour
items.photo_requirement: Underside and exterior

items.title: Rangehood removable grease filters
items.procedure: Only remove if safely reachable and manual allows. Wash metal filters by approved method, dry and refit; never wash disposable charcoal filters unless explicitly permitted. Record charcoal replacement due per actual manual for owner.
items.condition_trigger: Grease loading, reduced extraction or filter alert
items.photo_requirement: Removed cleaned filter and refitted filter; confirm dry/refitted

items.title: Stove/cooktop surfaces
items.procedure: Cool and switch off; remove spills using cooktop-type approved product/tool. Clean removable parts only as manual permits and dry/refit. No gas jets, igniters, wiring or caustic oven cleaner on incompatible tops.
items.condition_trigger: Burnt spills, grease or cracked glass; damage escalates
items.photo_requirement: Whole cooktop and key dirty-area close-up

items.title: Kettle exterior and base surroundings
items.procedure: Unplug safely, cool, wipe compatible outside with lightly damp cloth, dry; keep base/connector dry. Internal descaling is a separate manual-led task.
items.condition_trigger: Fingerprints, splashes or damage
items.photo_requirement: Kettle exterior/base surroundings

items.title: Toaster exterior
items.procedure: Unplug and cool; wipe exterior and dry. Never insert tools into slots or immerse. Crumb-tray servicing only as a separate approved manual-led scope.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs outside, grease or damaged cord
items.photo_requirement: Outside and surrounding surface, no internal-clean claim

items.title: Coffee-machine exterior
items.procedure: Switch off, cool and isolate safely; wipe exterior with approved cloth and dry. Brewing parts, milk circuits and descaling need separate model instructions and any after-use requirements.
items.condition_trigger: Splashes, coffee residue, leaks or alert
items.photo_requirement: Exterior and counter below visible edges

items.title: Rice-cooker exterior
items.procedure: Unplug, cool, wipe outside and dry; no liquid in connector/vents. Bowl, lid, steam valve and food-contact cleaning require the model's after-use instructions, separate from exterior proof.
items.condition_trigger: Food marks, odour, spills or cord damage
items.photo_requirement: Exterior and visible surrounding surface

items.title: Dishwasher exterior and handle
items.procedure: Wipe handle/front using finish-approved cloth; dry and avoid controls/vents. Stainless steel: follow grain if manufacturer advises.
items.condition_trigger: Fingerprints, grease or drips
items.photo_requirement: Full front and handle

items.title: Fridge top, safely reachable
items.procedure: Clean reachable top using compatible dry/very lightly damp tool without climbing or moving appliance. Do not obstruct ventilation or touch rear coils/wiring.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, objects blocking clearance or spills
items.photo_requirement: Top as safely visible; record inaccessible area

items.title: Wardrobe tops, safely reachable
items.procedure: Dust reachable top from floor using suitable tool; no climbing, heavy item removal or leaning furniture. Escalate inaccessible top.
items.condition_trigger: Dust or stored objects at risk of falling
items.photo_requirement: Top surface where safely visible

items.title: Under movable rugs, each rug
items.procedure: Lift/roll only lightweight movable rug safely; vacuum floor and rug underside, clean floor as approved and dry before replacing flat. No fitted carpet lifting or heavy furniture moving.
items.condition_trigger: Grit, odour, damp or curling/slip hazard
items.photo_requirement: Exposed floor and rug underside before reset

items.title: Shower drain, accessible hair trap
items.procedure: Wear gloves; remove visible hair from accessible lift-out strainer only where designed/manual permits; dispose in bin, clean/refit cover and check normal flow. No drain chemicals, deep probing or plumbing removal.
items.condition_trigger: Hair, pooling, odour or slow drainage
items.photo_requirement: Clear accessible trap/cover; report persistent slow flow

items.title: Bathroom sink drain, accessible hair/debris
items.procedure: Wear gloves; remove accessible hair at plug/strainer using safe approved method; clean and refit user-removable part only. No trap disassembly or chemicals. Report persistent blockage.
items.condition_trigger: Hair, slow flow, odour or leak
items.photo_requirement: Accessible plug/strainer and basin; no hidden-drain claim

items.title: Fans, each portable or ceiling fan
items.procedure: Switch off, allow blades to stop and isolate safely. Dust only safely reachable exterior/blades using manual-approved method. Ceiling fan must be reachable from floor; no ladder, dismantling or motor internals.
items.condition_trigger: Dust on blades, wobble, noise or damage; stop use/report unsafe condition
items.photo_requirement: Whole named fan and blade/detail or access limitation

items.title: Plants, each living plant: watering-needs check
items.procedure: Check plant label, soil moisture by approved method, leaf condition and drainage. Water only when species/soil instructions indicate; record water/no-water and reason. Empty accessible saucer as appropriate; no fixed fortnightly watering.
items.condition_trigger: Dry soil for species, wilting, pests, standing water; increase checks in heat/rapid drying
items.photo_requirement: Whole plant plus soil/pot; record moisture observation and amount if watered

items.title: Skirting boards, each room (recommended addition)
items.procedure: Vacuum/dust accessible skirting, wipe marks with finish-compatible cloth and dry. No furniture moving beyond safe approved light items.
items.condition_trigger: Dust, scuffs or moisture damage
items.photo_requirement: Named room skirting and corners

items.title: Bathroom exhaust grille, reachable exterior (recommended addition)
items.procedure: Switch fan off; dust/vacuum safely reachable exterior from floor only. Do not remove cover, touch wiring or climb.
items.condition_trigger: Dust mat, poor extraction, noise or damp
items.photo_requirement: Whole grille and visible dust/issue

items.title: Fridge door gaskets (recommended addition)
items.procedure: Wipe accessible gasket folds using manual-approved cloth/product, dry and check closure. Do not pull seal out; no abrasive or incompatible chemicals.
items.condition_trigger: Crumbs, stickiness, torn seal or poor closure
items.photo_requirement: Gasket folds and affected corner

items.title: Mattress surface/seams inspection (recommended addition)
items.procedure: During booked linen work, inspect exposed surface and seams; vacuum only if care label permits. No wet extraction or flipping heavy mattress. Pest signs: stop, photograph and report; do not spread bedding between rooms.
items.condition_trigger: Stains, odour, pest signs or damaged protector
items.photo_requirement: Exposed named mattress surface/seams, discreet close-up if issue

items.title: Bathroom sealant/grout condition check (recommended addition)
items.procedure: Inspect accessible shower/basin sealant and grout for gaps, persistent discolouration or damp. Clean ordinary surface residue only with compatible product; suspected mould or failed seals go to owner maintenance, no chemical mixing or re-sealing.
items.condition_trigger: New gaps, black spots, persistent damp or leaks
items.photo_requirement: Affected joint plus wider location

items.title: Accessible user-serviceable appliance filters (recommended addition)
items.procedure: Inventory actual model and filter type. Inspect only if safely accessible and approved manual allows. Cleaning/replacement interval must be set from manual before auto-enabling; no ladder, electrical covers or generic washing of disposable filters.
items.condition_trigger: Visible loading, warning indicator, airflow loss or odour
items.photo_requirement: Filter condition and refitted position; record manual/part ID
